message.abstract: The importance of the attention mechanism in CV is growing, as it allows a neural network to focus more on what it should pay attention to. Channel attention and spatial attention are the two basic attention strategies now in use. Using one of them alone can enhance to some level, while combining the two is more beneficial, but it adds to the computational burden. We propose a Channel and Spatial Attention Fusion Module(CSAFM), besides the use of channel and spatial information, GroupNorm and reorganization operation are applied to enhance the ability of feature extraction and feature representation of feature maps, which can capture more details as the feature deepens. Only a few additional parameters are added while enhancing the network. It is a plug-and-play module. We validate our CSAFM through extensive experiments on PASCAL VOC2007 and MS COCO2017 datasets, which shows that our module is effective yet efficient.e.g., it has risen by 1.47%, 2.1%, and 1.59%, respectively, under the frameworks of VGG16, ResNet50, and ResNet101 compared to baseline. Code is available at https://github.com/zero-yan/FasterRCNN.git.
title: Channel and Spatial Attention Fusion Module for Detection
